editor.label: Note content
editor.contentError: This note couldn't be opened — its content is in an unexpected format. Editing is disabled so the stored version isn't overwritten.

page.deleteConfirmBody: The note and any files attached to it will be deleted. This can't be undone.
page.deleteError: Couldn't delete the note. Try again.
page.notFoundDescription: This note may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

list.heading: Notes
list.emptyDescription: Notes are for reference material that outlives a task — meeting minutes, research, decisions.
list.loadErrorDescription: Something went wrong fetching this project's notes.
list.createError: Couldn't create the note. Try again.

save.error: Couldn't save — your changes are still here. Keep editing to retry.
save.conflictBody: Someone (or another tab) saved this note while you were editing. To avoid overwriting that version, saving is paused. Copy anything you want to keep, then reload to get the latest.
